text: AC1 classifies every post-execution GitHub error, including publication errors, as an outcome that publishes no review. The existing flow has a terminal check-run publication failure after the review is already public, so this contradicts the stated preservation of existing publication/check-run behavior and leaves that real outcome unspecified. Separate post-review failures from failures before review publication and define the review, check-run, and per-category-record surfaces for each.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in f57cbef, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
